Cess 17-Inch Laptop Tote Bag for Women with Stanley Cup Pocket

Organized. Equipped. Effortlessly Stylish.

Designed for women who carry more and expect their bag to keep up - the Cess Tote Bag blends elegant design with serious functionality. From long workdays to busy commutes and travel, this spacious tote keeps your laptop, tumbler, and daily essentials secure, organized, and easy to access.

Why You’ll Love It

Fits Large Laptops with Ease
A fully padded, independent laptop compartment safely fits laptops up to 17.3 inches, along with tablets and documents — no squeezing, no compromise.

Built-In Stanley Cup Pocket
An interior elastic pocket is specially designed to hold large tumblers, including the 40oz Stanley Cup, keeping spills contained and your tote bag balanced.

Exceptional Organization
A spacious main compartment pairs with an internal organizer panel featuring pen slots, small pockets, and side compartments for chargers, power banks, and essentials.

Discreet Security Pockets

  • Front discreet pocket for quick-access items like your phone or keys

  • Rear hidden anti-theft pocket to protect valuables such as wallets or passports

Includes a Detachable Sling Bag
A versatile mini sling lets you separate small items or head out light when you don’t need the full tote.

Designed for Comfort & Versatility

  • Adjustable, removable padded shoulder strap for shoulder or crossbody carry

  • Reinforced top handles for a polished hand-carry or forearm look

  • Lightweight design with balanced weight distribution

  • Easily transitions from tote → work bag → travel companion

Durable, Protective & Made to Last

  • Water-resistant cross-pattern PU leather exterior

  • Reinforced stitching and durable hardware

  • Protective bottom feet to prevent wear and maintain structure

  • Scratch-resistant finish for everyday durability

Dimensions

  • Width: 5.5 in

Available Colors

  • Emerald Green (Limited Edition with Red Lining)

  • Black (Limited Edition with Red Lining)

  • Cracked

  • Spice

  • Grey

Perfect For

  • Professional women carrying large laptops

  • Commuters and business travelers

  • Students, teachers, and academics

  • Anyone looking for a stylish, high-capacity, multifunctional tote

The Cess Tote Bag
Where generous space meets elegant design—built for days that demand more from your bag.

products.title: Denri Imani Handbag | Secure Zip Closure, Laptop-Friendly & Versatile Carry Options
products.body_html:
The Imani Handbag is a refined blend of elegance, functionality, and confidence designed for the modern woman on the move. Crafted with a structured yet soft silhouette, the Imani Handbag combines luxury design with practical everyday use. Its spacious interior comfortably fits a laptop up to 13 inches, making it an ideal companion for work, meetings, travel, and daily life. Thoughtful features such as a secure zipper closure, side stoppers that lock the mouth ends to maintain the bag’s shape, and a convenient back pocket for quick-access items ensure both elegance and functionality.

Designed with dual carry options, including classic top handles and an adjustable shoulder strap, the Imani Handbag adapts effortlessly to different lifestyles and occasions.Available in black, red, brown, nude, and green, the bag offers versatile color choices that complement both professional and casual wardrobes.

products.title: Denri | Nala Tote Bag | Dual-Texture Suede & Faux Leather Tote | Gold Hardware, Laptop-Ready
products.body_html:
Meet the Nala — the tote that speaks before you do.

Bold colour. Dual texture. Gold finish. The Nala Tote Bag is designed for the woman who wants a premium-feeling bag that transitions effortlessly from office to outing — without compromising on style.

The Nala's dual-texture exterior is entirely intentional: rich suede velvet meets smooth faux leather in a tactile combination that commands attention at every angle. Finished with premium gold hardware throughout — zippers, studs, and logo plate — it carries the aesthetic of a luxury designer piece at a fraction of the price.
